theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (P : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)), ((fun p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ => MvPolynomial.pderiv (1 : Fin 2) p)^[n + 1] P.val) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Induction shows that k Y-derivatives annihilate any monomial whose Y-exponent is less than k. Homogeneity bounds every supported monomial’s Y-exponent by n. Expand P into its finite monomial sum and distribute the iterated linear derivative; every summand vanishes after n+1 derivatives, including when n=0.
